# Generated by ble_protocol_tests --dump-golden and reviewed as the v1 wire
# compatibility contract. Hex is lowercase; multi-frame values use ';'.
# HomeLocation (0x16) is additive: it is only sent to a peer that advertises
# CapabilityHomeLocation, and the other payload layouts are unchanged.
# SettingsState (0x17) is additive for the same reason: it is gated on
# CapabilityDeviceSettings and no existing payload moved.
# The 0x17 payload grew from 14 to 16 bytes on 2026-10-22 (ambient_night and
# show_buildings) without a payload revision bump; both endpoints were updated
# together and the old shape is now rejected as trailing bytes.
# GnssInput (0x18) is additive: it is gated on CapabilityGnssInput, and no
# existing payload moved.
# PerformanceRun (0x19) is additive: the device sends it only to a phone that
# advertises CapabilityPerformanceRun.
# WifiConfig (0x1A) and WifiStatus (0x1B) are additive: both are gated on
# CapabilityWifiHotspot and no existing payload moved. The wifi_config PSK is a
# fixture value, not a credential.
# OtaCommand (0x1C) and OtaStatus (0x1D) are additive and gated on
# CapabilityOta. The URL is a fixture value; the digest is a pattern, not a
# released image, and the phone sends the real one when the rider updates.
# FirmwareInfo (0x1E) is additive and gated on CapabilityFirmwareInfo. The
# build is a fixture commit, not a released one.
# MapScene (0x14) areas are an optional trailing section gated on
# CapabilityMapAreas (2026-10-29). map_scene.payload is the layout every
# firmware decodes; map_scene_areas.payload is the same scene plus a lake and
# a park, and starts with exactly the same bytes.
